name: Kabocha
description: Dense sweet squash with edible skin — drier and sweeter than Western pumpkin.

tcm.note: Nan gua is warm and tonifies the spleen in TCM — unusually for a squash.

ayurveda.note: Madhura and mildly ushna; building and heavy.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
